subject: CAO responsibilities
summary: Delegated to Council the authority to establish the responsibilities of the Chief Administrative Officer and pass the related by-law.
outcome_context: Council later approved By-law 23-113 in a combined by-law vote on Nov. 27, 2023.

subject: 2024 draft budget direction
summary: Directed the Treasurer to prepare and present the draft 2024 operating and capital budget and provide updates to the Mayor.
outcome_context: Established the strong-mayor budget process for the 2024 budget.

subject: Propose the 2024 budget
authority: Municipal Act s. 284.16; O. Reg. 530/22 s. 7
summary: Formally proposed the City of Peterborough 2024 Operating and Capital Budget and Forecast.
outcome_context: Council budget amendments considered at the Dec. 11 meeting fall within the mayor-proposed budget process.

subject: Appoint IPGM Commissioner
authority: Municipal Act s. 284.13(1)2; O. Reg. 530/22 s. 6(2)
summary: Delegated to Council the authority to appoint the Commissioner of Infrastructure, Planning and Growth Management for the April 8 meeting.
outcome_context: Appointment was handled through the Council/closed-session process; a separate recorded public roll-call tied to the appointment has not been added to this archive.

subject: Appoint IPGM Commissioner
authority: Municipal Act s. 284.13(1)2; O. Reg. 530/22 s. 6(2)
summary: Again delegated to Council the authority to appoint the Commissioner of Infrastructure, Planning and Growth Management for the June 3 meeting.
outcome_context: Appointment was handled through the Council/closed-session process; a separate recorded public roll-call tied to the appointment has not been added to this archive.

subject: Appoint Municipal Operations Commissioner
authority: Municipal Act s. 284.13(1)2; O. Reg. 530/22 s. 6(2)
summary: Delegated to Council the authority to appoint the Commissioner of Municipal Operations.
outcome_context: Council approved the related appointment direction 10-0 at the Sept. 16 special meeting.

subject: Appeal 654-656 Stewart Street decision
summary: Directed City legal/planning staff to initiate an Ontario Land Tribunal appeal of a Committee of Adjustment refusal involving a proposed six-unit building.
outcome_context: This direction was rescinded ten days later by MDEC24-5 after the property owners filed their own appeal.

subject: Rescind City appeal; participate if required
summary: Rescinded MDEC24-4 and directed staff to assist the OLT if summoned in the owners’ appeal.

subject: Specific 2025 operating and capital budget items
authority: Municipal Act s. 284.16; O. Reg. 530/22 s. 7
summary: Proposed specific 2025 operating and capital budget items and delegated the decision on those items to Council for Dec. 9.
outcome_context: Part of the 2025 strong-mayor budget process; the broader budget process continued into January/February 2025.

subject: Brock Mission transitional housing at 738 Chemong Road
summary: Directed staff to prepare a zoning amendment and site-plan-control exemption for a transitional-housing project and bring the proposal to Council under strong-mayor provincial-priority authority.
outcome_context: On Feb. 24 both by-laws carried 4-7 because a mayor-proposed provincial-priority by-law passes with more than one-third of Council voting in favour.

subject: Defend Brock Mission by-laws in court
summary: Directed City lawyers and staff to oppose a proposed court challenge to By-laws 25-051 and 25-052 and report periodically to Council.
outcome_context: Follow-on strong-mayor direction arising from MDEC25-1 and the Feb. 24 by-law votes.

subject: 2026 draft budget direction
summary: Directed the Treasurer to prepare the 2026 draft budget, maintain current service levels with costing adjustments, and include an anticipated 10% Police Services increase due to legislative requirements.
outcome_context: Established the mayor-directed framework for the 2026 draft budget; Council deliberations before the formal proposal were recommendations to the Mayor.

subject: Propose the 2026 budget
authority: Municipal Act s. 284.16; O. Reg. 530/22 s. 7
summary: Formally proposed the 2026 Operating and Capital Budget and Forecast.
outcome_context: The proposed budget reflected Council recommendations made during the draft-budget process; the statutory amendment/veto/override framework then applied.
